headline: Brent is back near $110 on Gulf/Hormuz attack risk while the 10-year sits around 5.1%, with the FOMC, GDP/PCE and Microsoft/Alphabet/Amazon earnings all landing next week.
rates: The 10-year Treasury yield was about 5.08% on Oct 22, down roughly 5 bp from the prior session after a recent selloff took yields to multi-decade highs.
fed: The FOMC meets Oct 27-28 with the decision on Oct 28 at 2:00 PM ET; I could not confirm Fed speakers for this week.
oil: Brent is about $110 (settled $108.82 on Oct 21) as attacks on shipping near Hormuz and Houthi strikes on Saudi targets raise supply-disruption fears.
geo: The US ordered some diplomats out of Saudi Arabia after Houthi attacks, Iran-related shipping attacks continue in the Gulf, and Iran says it will not talk while being blockaded.
